title: Open dimension partition of a fibre Cohen-Macaulay open
statement: Let f:X→T be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], U an open of T, with f restricted over U flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let W be an open of X such that for every y in W, f(y) is in U and the depth [def-weil-pbc-depth] of the local ring of the fibre X_{f(y)} at y [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] equals its ring Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. There is a family V_n of opens of X indexed by natural numbers whose union is W, whose members are pairwise disjoint, and such that at every y in V_n the local topological dimension of the original fibre at y [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point] is n.

proof.text: Regard W as an open subscheme of the source restricted over U and restrict f to W. Flatness and local finite presentation are preserved by open restriction and composition with open immersions. Fibres are locally Noetherian. Original and restricted fibre stalks are isomorphic local rings by the restriction pullback squares. The depth hypothesis says that every stalk of every fibre of W→U is Cohen-Macaulay.

Apply 02NM to W→U to obtain clopen subschemes W_n, indexed by natural relative dimension n, whose coproduct is W. By 02NJ the nonempty fibres of W_n→U are equidimensional of dimension n. At a point of such a fibre, 0A21 (5) identifies local topological dimension with the maximum of dimensions of components through the point, so it is n; 0A21 (3) gives the open-neighbourhood formulation used by topologicalKrullDimAt. These assertions hold for locally algebraic schemes and may be checked on finite-type affine neighbourhoods.

The inclusions of the fibres of W_n into the original fibres are open immersions. Apply the already proved IsOpen.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq [lem-weil-pbc-dimension-at-point-open-subspace] after identifying the fibre with its open image. This preserves local topological dimension: neighbourhoods inside that image are cofinal among all neighbourhoods. Map W_n into X to obtain V_n. These images are open because the inclusion W→X is open. They cover W and are pairwise disjoint by the coproduct decomposition, and transport gives the claimed dimension equality. For empty W use all empty V_n; empty fibres impose no condition.

theorem exists_fibre_dimension_open_partition_of_depth_eq_ringKrullDim
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (U : T.Opens)
    [Flat (f ∣_ U)] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation (f ∣_ U)] (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : ∀ y ∈ W, f y ∈ U ∧
      (IsLocalRing.depth (R := (f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))
        ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
          ringKrullDim ((f.fiber (f y)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber y))) :
    ∃ V : ℕ → X.Opens, (⨆ n, V n) = W ∧
      Pairwise (fun m n => Disjoint (V m) (V n)) ∧
      ∀ n y, y ∈ V n → topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber y) = (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
